content: वियुक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Detached, severed, separated. .²2 Separated from, deserted by; तया वियुक्तस्य विलग्नमध्यया <ls>V. 4. 66</ls>. .²3 Free from, deprived of (with <ab>instr.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>). .²4 Failing, deficient. .²5 Disunited (as husband and wife); यथा नाभिचरेतां तौ वियुक्तावितरेतरम् <ls>Ms. 9. 102</ls>.
